definitions.gloss: activeness; acting of one's own will; active voice
definitions.explanation: Acting on one's own initiative rather than being acted upon; also the grammatical active voice. The antonym of {受動|じゅどう} (passive). Most often seen in the form {能動的|のうどうてき} (active, proactive).

examples.japanese: {能動|のうどう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{受動|じゅどう}→受動：12070_judou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{対|つい}→対：00411_tsui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{概念|がいねん}→概念：04709_gainen⟧だ。
examples.english: Active and passive are paired concepts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学習|がくしゅう}→学習：02623_gakushuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{能動|のうどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: In learning, an active attitude is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{能動|のうどう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{受動|じゅどう}→受動：12070_judou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: In English grammar, the verb form changes between the active and passive voice.

notes:
The antonym of ⟦{受動|じゅどう}→受動：12070_judou⟧ (passive). Refers to acting of one's own will, and to the grammatical active voice. Most common in the form ⟦{能動的|のうどうてき}→能動的：13963_noudouteki⟧ (proactive, active).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{能動的|のうどうてき}→能動的：13963_noudouteki⟧: active; proactive
- {能動|のうどう}{態|たい}: active voice (grammar)
- {能動|のうどう}⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧: active smoking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{受動|じゅどう}→受動：12070_judou⟧: passive — the direct antonym
